name: FrogInPan
description: Frog-in-the-Pan (Da, Gurun & Warachka 2014). Ranks stocks by a composite of 12-month momentum + win-rate (number of positive months). Investors under-react to small, continuous positive news.

signal.expr:
where(
  mom_weight * rank(roll_sum(shift(log_ret, 1), lookback))
  + (1 - mom_weight) * rank(roll_sum(shift((ret > 0) + 0 * ret, 1), lookback)),
  roll_max(shift((ret > 1.0) | (ret < -0.9), 1), lookback) != 1
)
